notes: One body. Fighters and hoopers are no longer built out of separate blocks: the torso, neck, shoulders, arms, fists, legs and bare feet are now one continuous, sculpted skin that bends at the joints like a real body. Muscles (pecs, abs, biceps, quads, calves) are shaped into it, and clothes, kits, socks, tights, sleeves and tattoos are painted right onto it instead of floating on top. Blood drips run over the real shape of the body.
